text: This report responds to a request from City Council at its meeting in October 2019 that the City Manager, in consultation with the Auditor General, report on the mechanisms required that would enable the Auditor General to conduct risk assessments or investigate cyber security for City Agencies and Corporations not currently within the Auditor General's purview. This report therefore outlines the existing mechanisms which may be used by the Auditor General to conduct risk assessments or investigate cyber security for City Agencies and Corporations not currently within the Auditor General's purview. These Agencies and Corporations are specifically identified as Toronto Hydro Corporation and its subsidiaries, Toronto Police Services, Toronto Public Library and Toronto Board of Health.
